reviews.review_title: A VR Escape Room Where Students Learn
reviews.review_description:
Finally, a VR Escape Room where students can truly learn! I found this VR Escape Room to be an incredible educational VR experience that transforms learning into an interactive adventure. It’s designed to complement the Pyramids of Egypt virtual world, this experience places students inside an authentic problem based learning challenge where they must use mathematics, astronomy, hieroglyphics, collaboration, and critical thinking skills to progress.

Students are not just observing history they are actively engaging with it. The escape room encourages teamwork, communication, and creative problem solving as learners work together to uncover clues and unlock the next stage of their journey. 

I feel that this is a powerful example of how VR can support immersive learning by connecting academic concepts with hands on experiences. Pharaoh’s Vault Escape Room is an excellent resource for classrooms, STEM programs, and educators looking to inspire curiosity while building real world skills.
